authority: adversarial verification of my own cross-check, four independent agents
why_this_exists: I reported four conclusions about the owner's Reference v2 card. Three were wrong. They are corrected here rather than in the earlier commit message, which stands as written (R6).

WITHDRAWN_1_registry_depth.what_I_said: Nine of fifteen doses disagree and the mechanism is registry depth.
WITHDRAWN_1_registry_depth.why: The owner's dose is reproduced EXACTLY, 15 of 15, by a binary weight rule on their own hardcoded table: dose = (slots with starter_weight > 0) / 2, read straight out of data/reference/2026-08-23_reference_sim_output.json. reference_sim.py lines 41-57 carry the literal 'None, 0' for BOTH slots of STL@PHI, WSH@MIA, TB@BAL, DET@KC, CLE@COL and MIN@SD — precisely their six 0.0 games.
WITHDRAWN_1_registry_depth.the_decisive_argument: A thinner registry can only LOWER a dose. The owner's dose EXCEEDS mine on PIT@LAD (1.0 vs 0.0) and NYM@CWS (1.0 vs 0.5). Disagreement in both directions cannot be produced by monotone thinness. Brute-forcing every games-started threshold T in 0..39 for dose=(slots with gs>=T)/2 reproduces the owner's vector at NO value of T: ATH@HOU (gs 7 and 4) scores 1.0 while MIN@SD (gs 14 and 20) scores 0.0, so no single cutoff can order them. Pearson r between the two dose vectors is -0.07.
WITHDRAWN_1_registry_depth.what_it_actually_is: A differently-populated table, not a shallower one. Recovering implied gs from weight = gs/(gs+10): the reference carries gs=26 for Abbott (repo 20), 25 for Soriano (20), 25 for Imanaga (20), 25 for McLean (20), 21 for Mahle (15), 8 for Bratt (2) — while carrying NOTHING at all for Valdez, Buehler, Sanchez, Baz, Sugano and Martinez. A registry cannot be missing Valdez and Buehler while inflating Bratt fourfold.

WITHDRAWN_2_not_a_classifier_difference.why: There IS one, and it drives exactly the two games my claim leaned on. information_class.LOW_SAMPLE_GS = 2 excludes a one-start pitcher from the resolved numerator; the reference's rule is binary weight>0, so a one-start line counts as full information. That is the whole of the PIT@LAD (Snell gs=1) and NYM@CWS (Newcomb gs=1) divergence.
WITHDRAWN_2_not_a_classifier_difference.what_survives: The substantive point stands on its own evidence: a one-start line is not full information. It is simply a classifier disagreement, which is what I denied.

WITHDRAWN_3_no_mlb_board_on_disk.what_I_said: The MLB market column has no counterpart on disk.
WITHDRAWN_3_no_mlb_board_on_disk.where_it_is: data/reference/2026-08-23_reference_README.md, section '## MLB board audit', a committed tracked file I had already read. PHI -210, LAD -301 and BOS -231 — the three prices I singled out as unverifiable — all match verbatim, as do the other twelve and every total.
WITHDRAWN_3_no_mlb_board_on_disk.how_I_missed_it: I looked in data/mlb/odds/ and in the uploaded novig_market_board.json, concluded from those two that no board existed, and did not re-read the README section I had already opened.

WITHDRAWN_4_wnba_different_models.what_I_said: Different models, so the disagreeing WNBA probabilities are not a contradiction.
WITHDRAWN_4_wnba_different_models.why: The reference's four WNBA probabilities are HARDCODED LITERALS at reference_sim.py lines 60-65: p_home 0.682646 / 0.302283 / 0.225150 / 0.475263, reprinted verbatim in the README. The RNG in that loop touches only margin and total; the winner probability is never simulated. And the model id the README attributes them to, wnba.rs.fourfactor_logit_ridge.v0_5.shadow, has exactly ONE occurrence in the entire repository — that README line itself. It resolves to no source, no pin, no artifact.
WITHDRAWN_4_wnba_different_models.correct_framing: One registered WNBA model (wnba.rs.ff7_logit_ridge.v1_0.shadow, which produces DAL .7491 when run today) versus four typed-in constants. 'Different model' cannot exculpate a gap when the second side is not a model output at all.

UPHELD_sha_unverifiable.claim: Card SHA 6fd05e87021e92092744f2bd3aa87c984bd9f359fee6bb3424d3ddf85a6430cf matches nothing in this repository.
UPHELD_sha_unverifiable.method: all 1310 non-.git files hashed; each re-hashed in 5 byte variants (raw, strip, rstrip-newline, plus-newline, CRLF); every parseable json/jsonl re-serialised 10 ways (sort_keys x indent 1/2/compact x ensure_ascii); all 2181 git blobs including unreachable and dangling objects. Zero matches. The literal string and four 8-char fragments of it appear nowhere in the tree, including .git.

NEW_FINDING_board_overround_is_bimodal.test: the standing same-book test: one book runs about +4-6%, cross-book best-odds +0.4-0.6%
NEW_FINDING_board_overround_is_bimodal.reading: A genuine single-book board is homogeneous in overround. This one is BIMODAL: eight rows sit in the single-book band and seven sit near 1.7%, which is too tight for one book and too wide for pure best-odds. Under the 2026-08-03 ruling the seven tight rows do not clear the same-book bar and their de-vig is INVALID for market probability — single-price EV screening only. The eight wide rows pass.
NEW_FINDING_board_overround_is_bimodal.note: This is the check I should have run instead of asserting the board did not exist.

MY_DEFECTS_CONFIRMED: The committed three-arm card stamped a card-level dose of 0.80 on all 15 rows AND a flat information_class of PARTIAL_STARTER_INFORMATION. The class was the more consequential half: grading_keys keys on it, and it granted PIT@LAD — a true ALL_CAP game — GATE_GOVERNED authority where ALL_CAP_BASELINE maps to NONE. Both are fixed in the current card.
ATL@MIL was given Milwaukee's park factor at a neutral site. Fixed; all three arms blocked.
